orgora-charts-cloud.note: Grok Bot / remote: Connect discovers OAuth at orgora-mcp.sdkaihub.com (RFC 9728). User signs in with Google or Microsoft (same SSO as Orgora). Charts stay in their Drive or OneDrive.

orgora-charts.note: Mac desktop / Grok Build only. Local stdio helper from Orgora Charts → MCP connector → Enable. No network. If missing, tell the user to Enable — this plugin does not download a binary.
